events.title: UBS reiterates Neutral on ONEOK stock after Permian acquisition
events.summary: UBS has reiterated its Neutral rating and $108 price target for ONEOK Inc. following the company's acquisition of Brazos Midstream’s Permian Midland Basin assets for $4.4 billion. This acquisition is expected to significantly increase ONEOK's Permian processing capacity and enhance its Permian franchise, despite the stock currently trading near its 52-week high. Separately, ONEOK reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, beating EPS estimates and raising its full-year outlook, leading Freedom Broker to upgrade the stock to Buy.

articles.headline: UBS reiterates Neutral on ONEOK stock after Permian acquisition

Strong demand for Garmin's fitness products also contributed to the positive results, highlighting the company's strong earnings power beyond just unit growth. The company's high-end fenix series watches continue to keep the brand visible, while investors focus on the earnings update to justify a potentially higher stock range.

events.title: Cisco Systems stock steady after earnings beat and upbeat guidance
events.summary: Cisco Systems stock remained steady at around $109 after the company reported double-digit revenue growth and an EPS beat in its latest quarter, exceeding consensus estimates. The networking giant also provided upbeat guidance for fiscal year 2027, projecting strong earnings growth and a positive outlook for the first quarter. Analysts maintain a "moderate buy" consensus rating with an average price target implying significant upside, supported by Cisco's strong margins, dividend payments, and strategic positioning in the AI and cloud infrastructure markets.

articles.headline: Cisco Systems stock steady after earnings beat and upbeat guidance

events.title: ONEOK to Acquire Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin Assets for $4.425 Billion
events.summary: ONEOK, Inc. announced a definitive agreement to acquire Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin assets for $4.425 billion. This acquisition will be funded by a $9 billion nonvoting minority equity investment from Apollo funds, with $5 billion used to reduce ONEOK's existing debt. The deal is expected to be immediately accretive to earnings and free cash flow per share, accelerating ONEOK's deleveraging and growth in the Permian Midland Basin.

events.title: Tariff refunds lift TJX (NYSE: TJX) profit and Q2 EPS
events.summary: TJX Companies, Inc. (TJX) reported strong Q2 fiscal 2027 results with net sales up 5% to $15.2 billion and diluted EPS of $1.36, a significant increase from $1.10 in the prior year. The improved profitability was largely driven by a net benefit of $219 million from IEEPA tariff refunds, which contributed $0.14 to EPS, though these refunds are noted as a non-recurring factor. The company also demonstrated robust operating cash flow and returned $1.3 billion to shareholders through repurchases and dividends, while increasing its long-term global store target to 7,500 locations.

articles.headline: Tariff refunds lift TJX (NYSE: TJX) profit and Q2 EPS

events.title: Resilient Amcor stock steadies after Q3 FY26 earnings beat and new packaging moves
events.summary: Amcor's stock remained stable in the mid-$40s after reporting strong Q3 FY26 results, including higher revenue of $5.91 billion and a net profit of $278 million, surpassing analyst expectations. The company's focus on sustainable packaging solutions, such as seaweed-based coatings, and investments in healthcare packaging automation are seen as key drivers for long-term growth. Despite broader market volatility, Amcor's operational execution and strategic initiatives continue to support its competitive position in defensive end markets.

articles.headline: Resilient Amcor stock steadies after Q3 FY26 earnings beat and new packaging moves

events.title: Political pushback to the NextEra-Dominion deal has spread to New England
events.summary: The proposed $67-billion merger between NextEra and Dominion Energy, which would create the world's largest regulated utility, is facing increasing political opposition beyond Virginia, spreading to New England states. Governors from Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, and Vermont have voiced concerns about the unprecedented concentration of leverage and its potential impact on regional energy markets and ratepayers. This pushback is partly fueled by NextEra's past attempts to block a major transmission line in Maine, raising questions about the deal's ultimate approval despite company assurances of a "win-win" scenario.

articles.headline: Political pushback to the NextEra-Dominion deal has spread to New England

events.title: Americans of All Incomes Head to Dollar Stores to Stay Frugal
events.summary: Dollar General and Dollar Tree have reported significant sales gains and increased store traffic, driven by shoppers seeking value amidst economic uncertainty and higher gas prices. Both companies noted that while their core customers remain financially constrained, higher-income shoppers are also increasingly visiting their stores, highlighting a broader shift towards frugality. This trend comes as other major retailers like Walmart and Target are also focusing on price reductions to attract cost-conscious consumers.

articles.headline: Americans of All Incomes Head to Dollar Stores to Stay Frugal

events.title: Resilient Alphabet C stock weathers heavy AI capex after Q2 2026 earnings beat
events.summary: Alphabet Class C stock trades in the high $330s as of late August 2026, demonstrating resilience despite negative free cash flow from aggressive AI infrastructure investments. The company reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, with revenue up 24.23% and Google Cloud revenue surging 82%, alongside an expansion in cloud operating margin. While facing a $692 billion market value reduction due to AI execution risk concerns, Alphabet has initiated a dividend and authorized an $85 billion stock issuance to finance future growth.

articles.headline: Resilient Alphabet C stock weathers heavy AI capex after Q2 2026 earnings beat

events.title: Will Southwest’s New Premium Perks and Bag Fees Change Southwest Airlines' (LUV) Narrative?
events.summary: Southwest Airlines is introducing premium services like extra legroom, preferred seating, and new checked bag fees to boost profitability and potentially restore historical returns. This strategic shift aims to improve pricing without compromising its value reputation, with an estimated earnings power of US$6.00 per share. The success of these initiatives hinges on customer reaction and effective execution amidst demand uncertainty and cost pressures.
